1: ---
2: name: gsheets
3: description: Read, write, format, and manage Google Sheets. Use when the user shares a sheets.google.com or docs.google.com/spreadsheets URL, asks to read or summarize spreadsheet data, wants cells written, formatted, sorted, merged, or validated, wants rows/columns inserted or deleted, wants charts, pivot tables, or tables added, wants CSV imported, or wants a spreadsheet created, copied, shared, or exported. Don't use for Google Docs, Slides, or Drive file management.
4: ---
5: 
6: # Google Sheets
7: 
8: Work with a Google Sheet the user names or links to. Everything here assumes you
9: already have the **spreadsheet ID** — the segment between `/d/` and `/edit` in a
10: `https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/<SPREADSHEET_ID>/edit` URL.
11: 
12: > [!CAUTION]
13: >
14: > `mutate delete-sheet`, `mutate delete-rows`, `mutate delete-cols`, and `mutate
15: > clear` permanently remove data. **Never** run a destructive command the user
16: > did not explicitly ask for.
17: >
18: > `mutate delete` permanently deletes an entire spreadsheet document. Never use
19: > it unless the user asks explicitly; ask for confirmation and wait for the
20: > answer before executing. The command also requires `--confirm`.
21: >
22: > **Never** share a spreadsheet with a broad audience, a public link, or a whole
23: > organization. The user already has access to anything created on their behalf
24: > — let them handle sharing unless they explicitly instruct otherwise.
25: 
26: ## Setup
27: 
28: Run this skill's script once, before anything else. It downloads the CLI for
29: this machine, registers `gsheets` on the agent's `PATH` (not the user's shell),
30: and prints the version:
31: 
32: ```bash
33: <path/to/this/skill>/scripts/gsheets --version
34: ```
35: 
36: ```powershell
37: # Windows (PowerShell)
38: & "<path\to\this\skill>\scripts\gsheets.cmd" --version
39: ```
40: 
41: After that, always run bare `gsheets`, never the script by its path: only
42: `gsheets` gets the user's sign-in. Never ask the user to run it; they cannot.
43: 
44: ## Authentication
45: 
46: Run bare `gsheets` and let the result tell you how sign-in works. Don't search
47: the filesystem or environment for credentials, and don't ask the user for a
48: token.
49: 
50: -   **Antigravity manages sign-in** when a command fails with Antigravity's
51:     "needs authentication" message. Follow it: show the plugin card it gives and
52:     ask the user to click **Sign in** on it, then retry once they say they have
53:     signed in. Do not run `gsheets auth login` in this case. If more than one
54:     account is connected, choose one by prefixing the command with
55:     `AGY_ACCOUNT=<account>`, for example
56:     `AGY_ACCOUNT=me@example.com gsheets ...`. In PowerShell, set it first:
57:     `$env:AGY_ACCOUNT = "me@example.com"; gsheets ...`.
58: -   **The CLI manages sign-in** when it says
59:     `no credentials found: run gsheets auth login`. This version of Antigravity
60:     doesn't sign in for this plugin, so log in for the user: start
61:     `gsheets auth login` as a background command. It prints an authorization URL
62:     and exits on its own once the user approves. Read the URL from the task's
63:     log, open it in the user's browser or hand them the link, then stop and
64:     wait. Confirm with `gsheets auth status`, then retry.
65: -   A 403 that names a missing permission or scope is not a sign-in problem.
66:     Report it instead of asking the user to sign in again.
67: 
68: ## Usage
69: 
70: Do every Google Sheets operation — reading, writing, formatting, creating,
71: exporting — through `gsheets`. Commands are split into two namespaces:
72: `readonly` for anything that only reads, `mutate` for anything that changes the
73: spreadsheet. Run `gsheets --help`, or `gsheets <namespace> <command> --help`, to
74: confirm the exact flags of any command below.
75: 
76: Two rules the CLI's own help will not tell you:
77: 
78: -   **Never run a destructive command the user did not ask for.** Deleting a
79:     spreadsheet, a sheet, or rows, and clearing a range, all discard data with
80:     no undo on the user's side. Ask first and wait for an answer.
81: -   **Write the narrowest range that does the job.** Rewriting a whole sheet to
82:     change a few cells destroys formatting, formulas, and validation rules that
83:     were never yours to touch.
84: 
85: ## Recipes
86: 
87: **Read data (readonly):**
88: 
89: ```bash
90: gsheets readonly read SPREADSHEET_ID 'Sheet1!A1:D10'
91: gsheets readonly read-all SPREADSHEET_ID
92: gsheets readonly read-links SPREADSHEET_ID 'Sheet1!A1:D10'   # embedded hyperlinks, rich-text links, and smart chips
93: gsheets readonly info SPREADSHEET_ID
94: gsheets readonly list-sheets SPREADSHEET_ID
95: gsheets readonly list-named-ranges SPREADSHEET_ID
96: gsheets readonly list-filter-views SPREADSHEET_ID
97: gsheets readonly list "Quarterly Results"                    # search spreadsheets in Drive
98: gsheets readonly list-revisions SPREADSHEET_ID               # revision history
99: gsheets readonly inspect-cell SPREADSHEET_ID 'Sheet1!B4'     # deep cell and error diagnostics
100: gsheets readonly get-settings SPREADSHEET_ID                 # locale and timezone properties
101: gsheets readonly list-comments SPREADSHEET_ID                # comment threads and replies
102: ```
103: 
104: **Write data (mutate):**
105: 
106: ```bash
107: gsheets mutate write SPREADSHEET_ID 'Sheet1!A1:B2' "Name,Age|Alice,30"
108: gsheets mutate write SPREADSHEET_ID 'Sheet1!A1:B2' $'Name,Age\nAlice,30'
109: gsheets mutate write SPREADSHEET_ID 'Sheet1!A1' "Value with\, a comma"
110: gsheets mutate append SPREADSHEET_ID 'Sheet1!A1' "Bob,25"
111: gsheets mutate clear SPREADSHEET_ID 'Sheet1!A1:D10'
112: gsheets mutate import-csv SPREADSHEET_ID /path/to/data.csv
113: gsheets mutate find-replace SPREADSHEET_ID --find "old" --replace "new"
114: gsheets mutate notes SPREADSHEET_ID 'Sheet1!A1' "This is a note"
115: gsheets mutate add-comment SPREADSHEET_ID "This is a comment" --range 'Sheet1!A1:A1'
116: gsheets mutate reply-comment SPREADSHEET_ID COMMENT_ID "This is a reply"
117: gsheets mutate resolve-comment SPREADSHEET_ID COMMENT_ID "Optional resolve message"
118: ```
119: 
120: **Create, delete, copy, and rename (mutate):**
121: 
122: ```bash
123: gsheets mutate create --title "New Spreadsheet"
124: gsheets mutate delete SPREADSHEET_ID --confirm                       # permanently deletes the document
125: gsheets mutate rename SPREADSHEET_ID "New File Name"
126: gsheets mutate copy-spreadsheet SPREADSHEET_ID "Copy Title"
127: gsheets mutate add-sheet SPREADSHEET_ID --title "Sheet2"
128: gsheets mutate delete-sheet SPREADSHEET_ID --sheet-id 1
129: gsheets mutate rename-sheet SPREADSHEET_ID --sheet-id 0 --title "Main"
130: gsheets mutate copy-sheet SPREADSHEET_ID --sheet-id 0 --dest OTHER_SPREADSHEET_ID
131: gsheets mutate create-from-template TEMPLATE_ID --title "New" --replacements "{{NAME}}=Alice"
132: ```
133: 
134: **Formatting (mutate):**
135: 
136: ```bash
137: gsheets mutate format SPREADSHEET_ID --sheet-id 0 --start-row 0 --end-row 1 --start-col 0 --end-col 5 --bold --align CENTER --bg-color "#00FF00" --fg-color "#FF0000" --wrap
138: gsheets mutate set-col-width SPREADSHEET_ID --sheet-id 0 --start-col 0 --end-col 1 --pixels 200
139: gsheets mutate autosize SPREADSHEET_ID --sheet-id 0 --start-col 0 --end-col 5
140: gsheets mutate merge SPREADSHEET_ID --sheet-id 0 --start-row 0 --end-row 1 --start-col 0 --end-col 3
141: gsheets mutate unmerge SPREADSHEET_ID --sheet-id 0 --start-row 0 --end-row 1 --start-col 0 --end-col 3
142: gsheets mutate freeze SPREADSHEET_ID --sheet-id 0 --rows 1 --cols 1
143: gsheets mutate borders SPREADSHEET_ID --sheet-id 0 --style SOLID --color "#000000"
144: gsheets mutate conditional-format SPREADSHEET_ID --sheet-id 0 --start-row 0 --end-row 100 --start-col 0 --end-col 1 --condition NUMBER_GREATER --value "90" --color "#00FF00"
145: ```
146: 
147: **Rows, columns, and data operations (mutate):**
148: 
149: ```bash
150: gsheets mutate sort SPREADSHEET_ID --sheet-id 0 --col 0                 # --asc is default, omit for descending
151: gsheets mutate insert-rows SPREADSHEET_ID --range 'Sheet1!5:10'         # human-readable ranges work
152: gsheets mutate delete-rows SPREADSHEET_ID --range 'Sheet1!5:10'
153: gsheets mutate insert-cols SPREADSHEET_ID --range 'Sheet1!C:D'
154: gsheets mutate insert-cols SPREADSHEET_ID --sheet-id 0 --start 2 --count 3 --inherit-from-before   # append at the end (start may equal grid size)
155: gsheets mutate delete-cols SPREADSHEET_ID --range 'Sheet1!C:D'
156: gsheets mutate copy-paste SPREADSHEET_ID --sheet-id 0 --start-row 0 --end-row 5 --start-col 0 --end-col 2 --dest-row 0 --dest-col 3 --paste-type PASTE_VALUES
157: gsheets mutate auto-fill SPREADSHEET_ID --sheet-id 0 --start-row 0 --end-row 10 --start-col 0 --end-col 1 --source-end-row 3
158: gsheets mutate smart-fill SPREADSHEET_ID 'Sheet1!B2'                    # fills down the adjacent contiguous depth
159: gsheets mutate formula-fill SPREADSHEET_ID --range 'Sheet1!C1:C10' --formula "=B1+A1"   # shifts relative references
160: gsheets mutate data-validation SPREADSHEET_ID 'Sheet1!B1:B10' --values "Yes,No,Maybe"
161: gsheets mutate protect SPREADSHEET_ID --range 'Sheet1!A1:D1' --editors "alice@example.com,bob@example.com"
162: gsheets mutate change-settings SPREADSHEET_ID --locale "de_DE" --timezone "Europe/Berlin"
163: gsheets mutate add-named-range SPREADSHEET_ID "MyRange" 'Sheet1!A1:D10'
164: gsheets mutate add-filter-view SPREADSHEET_ID "MyFilter" --sheet-id 0
165: gsheets mutate delete-filter-view SPREADSHEET_ID 12345
166: ```
167: 
168: **Charts, pivots, tables, sharing, and export:**
169: 
170: ```bash
171: gsheets mutate add-chart SPREADSHEET_ID --sheet-id 0 --chart-type BAR --start-row 0 --end-row 10 --start-col 0 --end-col 2 --title "Sales"
172: gsheets mutate add-chart SPREADSHEET_ID --sheet-id 0 --chart-type COLUMN --start-row 0 --end-row 10 --start-col 0 --end-col 2 --title "Pillars" --overlay --colors "#4285F4,#EA4335"
173: gsheets readonly export-chart SPREADSHEET_ID --chart-id 1 --output /tmp/chart.png
174: gsheets mutate pivot SPREADSHEET_ID --source 'Sheet1!A1:D100' --target-sheet-id 0
175: gsheets readonly export SPREADSHEET_ID /tmp/export.csv --format csv
176: gsheets readonly export SPREADSHEET_ID /tmp/export_tab.csv --format csv --sheet "Sheet2"   # specific tab (CSV/TSV only)
177: gsheets readonly export SPREADSHEET_ID /tmp/page1.png --format png --page 1
178: gsheets mutate share SPREADSHEET_ID --email user@example.com --role writer
179: gsheets mutate add-table SPREADSHEET_ID "MyTable" 'Sheet1!A1:D10'
180: gsheets mutate update-table SPREADSHEET_ID "MyTable" 'Sheet1!A1:D20'
181: gsheets mutate delete-table SPREADSHEET_ID "MyTable"
182: gsheets mutate batch SPREADSHEET_ID -f requests.json
183: gsheets mutate raw-batch SPREADSHEET_ID -f raw_requests.json
184: ```
185: 
186: **Batch operations file (`requests.json`):**
187: 
188: Each op is one of `read`, `write`, `append`, or `clear`. For `write` and
189: `append`, the `data` field is **required** and must be a 2D array of rows
190: (`[[...]]`). Unknown JSON fields are rejected — typos surface immediately rather
191: than silently producing no-op writes.
192: 
193: ```json
194: [
195:   {"op": "read",   "range": "Sheet1!A1:B2"},
196:   {"op": "write",  "range": "Sheet1!A1",     "data": [["Critical", "High"]]},
197:   {"op": "append", "range": "Sheet1!A1",     "data": [["new row"]]},
198:   {"op": "clear",  "range": "Sheet1!A1:B2"}
199: ]
200: ```
201: 
202: > [!IMPORTANT]
203: >
204: > The field is `data`, not `values`. Writing `"values": "X"` fails with `parsing
205: > batch JSON: json: unknown field "values"`. This is deliberate: the field name
206: > that used to be silently accepted was a silent-data-loss footgun.
207:

275: 
276: ## Tips
277: 
278: -   **Creating Spreadsheets with Specific Tabs:** When creating a new
279:     spreadsheet with a specific tab/sheet name, note that `mutate create`
280:     generates a default initial tab ("Sheet 1", `--sheet-id 0`). You can either
281:     repurpose "Sheet 1" by renaming it (`mutate rename-sheet SPREADSHEET_ID
282:     --sheet-id 0 --title "Desired Tab Name"`) or add the new sheet and delete
283:     "Sheet 1" (`mutate delete-sheet SPREADSHEET_ID --sheet-id 0`).
284: -   **CRITICAL:** Never attempt to scrape Google Sheets URLs (e.g.,
285:     `docs.google.com/spreadsheets/...`) using web reading tools. Always use the
286:     GSheets CLI commands (`readonly read`, `readonly read-all`) to access
287:     spreadsheet contents, as the URLs require authentication and will return
288:     permission errors.
289: -   **LIMITATION:** Due to Google Sheets API and Drive API limitations, any
290:     comment created programmatically using `mutate add-comment` with a cell
291:     range anchor will appear as "Original Content Deleted" (unanchored) in the
292:     Google Sheets grid Web UI. However, the comment remains fully visible in the
293:     Sheets "Comment History" sidebar, and it is queryable/writable via the CLI's
294:     `list-comments`, `reply-comment`, and `resolve-comment` commands.
295: -   The `mutate format` command uses `--sheet-id`, `--start-row/--end-row`,
296:     `--start-col/--end-col` (not A1 range notation)
297: -   The `mutate notes` command takes range and note text as positional arguments
298:     (not --set flag)
299: -   Avoid spaces in sheet names when used in range notation; if unavoidable,
300:     wrap in single quotes: `"'My Sheet'!A1:B5"`
301: -   Chart types: `BAR`, `LINE`, `AREA` work reliably; `PIE` is listed but not
302:     supported by the API
303: -   Use `--json` on read commands to get machine-parseable output
304: -   Use `--markdown-links` on `readonly read-all` to extract rich-text
305:     hyperlinks and Smart Chips (Rich Links and People Chips) embedded in cells.
306:     Without this flag, the API returns only the display text, and hidden link
307:     targets or smart chip URIs are lost. With the flag, both standard links and
308:     smart chips (including People Chips as `mailto:` links) are rendered as
309:     `[display text](URL)`. Can be combined with `--json` to output an array of
310:     rows containing the markdown-formatted strings.
311: -   `readonly read-links RANGE` is the dedicated command (vs the
312:     `--markdown-links` flag above, which is scoped to `read-all`) to pull
313:     embedded hyperlinks, rich-text links, and Smart Chips (Rich Links and People
314:     Chips as `mailto:` links) from a specific range, rendered as `[display
315:     text](URL)`. Add `--json` for an array of rows, or `--debug-cell` to dump
316:     the raw `CellData` JSON for troubleshooting.
317: -   Use `--value-render-option FORMULA` on the `readonly read` command to
318:     retrieve the underlying cell formulas instead of the evaluated values.
319: -   `readonly export` supports `csv`, `xlsx`, `pdf`, `ods`, `tsv`, and `png`
320:     formats. When exporting to `csv` or `tsv`, you can use the `--sheet
321:     "TabName"` flag to export a specific sheet tab by name (by default, Drive
322:     CSV export only downloads the first tab).
323: -   Both `|` and `\n` (newline) work as row delimiters in `mutate write` and
324:     `mutate append` commands. Use `|` for inline values and `$'\n'` for
325:     multi-row shell input
326: -   To include a comma inside a cell value, escape it with a backslash: `\,`
327: -   `batch` requires `data` (not `values`) for `write`/`append` ops; unknown
328:     fields are rejected by the strict JSON decoder. See "Batch operations file"
329:     above.
330: -   `conditional-format --condition NUMBER_BETWEEN` (and `NUMBER_NOT_BETWEEN`,
331:     `DATE_BETWEEN`, `DATE_NOT_BETWEEN`) accept a comma-separated `--value` pair,
332:     e.g. `--value "1,10"`. Other conditions still take a single `--value`. For
333:     bands of multiple ranges (e.g. 1-2, 3-5, 6+), add one rule per band.
334: -   **Recommended workflow:** Use `readonly export SPREADSHEET_ID page.png
335:     --format png --page N` to export a specific page as an image, review it
336:     visually, then iterate on edits
337: 
338: ## Global Flags
339: 
340: -   `--json` — output as JSON (works with all read commands)
341: -   `-v`, `--version` — print the CLI build version
342: -   `--legacy-mode` — how deprecated/renamed commands are handled: `allowed` |
343:     `deprecated` (default) | `banned`

args.Content:
# Rencana Arsitektur & Implementasi: Google Apps Script Promo & Refund Helper

## 1. Ringkasan Proyek
Helper Google Apps Script ini dirancang untuk membaca konfigurasi promosi dan transaksi belanja dari tab `Input`, mencocokkan master produk dari tab `PLU Master`, menghitung distribusi pemenuhan stok saat terjadi partial refund, dan menyusun tab hasil baru bertingkat (`Result - 1`, `Result - 2`, dst.) di mana setiap sel perhitungan berisikan **formula Google Sheets** aktif (`=CEILING(...)`, `=ROUNDDOWN(...)`, `=VLOOKUP(...)`, dll) untuk keperluan analisa dan audit step-by-step.

---

## 2. Diagram Alur Kerja & Arsitektur Sistem

```mermaid
flowchart TD
    A["User klik Menu 'Simulasi Promo & Refund' -> 'Hitung & Buat Result Baru'"] --> B["Main.gs (Orchestrator)"]
    B --> C["DataLoader: Baca Tab 'Input' & 'PLU Master'"]
    C --> D{"Validasi Input"}
    D -- "Ada Error (PLU hilang / Qty invalid)" --> E["ui.alert() Tampilkan Pesan Error & Stop"]
    D -- "Valid" --> F["QtyDistributionService: Alokasi Qty Aktual ke Paket"]
    F --> G["Deteksi & Pemetaan Kolom Promosi Aktif"]
    G --> H["ResultSheetBuilder: Buat Tab 'Result - X'"]
    H --> I["Injeksi Formula Tabel SALES (Order Awal)"]
    H --> J["Injeksi Formula Tabel EDIT ORDER & Detail Transaksi"]
    H --> K["Injeksi Formula Tabel FULFILLMENT SALES (Order Aktual)"]
    H --> L["Injeksi Formula Tabel REFUND & Detail Transaksi Refund"]
    H --> M["Format Tampilan (Border, Warna Header, Format Rupiah)"]
    M --> N["Selesai & Notifikasi Tab Baru Siap Digunakan"]
```

---

## 3. Struktur Berkas Apps Script (Modular OOP)

Setiap tipe promosi dan logika perhitungan dipisahkan menjadi berkas `.gs` tersendiri menggunakan paradigma Object-Oriented Programming (OOP):

1. **`Main.gs`**
   - Entry point spreadsheet (`onOpen`).
   - Handler menu custom: `"Simulasi Promo & Refund"`.
   - Koordinasi orkestrasi pembacaan data, validasi, dan pembangkitan sheet result.

2. **`Models.gs`**
   - Definisi class model data: `Product`, `PromoRule`, `OrderItem`, `EditOrderSummary`.

3. **`DataLoader.gs`**
   - Service untuk membaca range data dari tab `PLU Master` dan `Input`.
   - Parsing aturan promo (`KODE PROMOSI INPUT`) dan baris transaksi awal.
   - Validasi data (mengecek keberadaan PLU, validitas Qty, angka numerik).

4. **`QtyDistributionService.gs`**
   - Logika cerdas untuk mendistribusikan total `Qty Aktual` per PLU dari Edit Order ke transaksi awal dengan hierarki prioritas:
     1. **Bundling** (Priority 1)
     2. **Hadiah PHG** (Priority 2)
     3. **Non-Paket / Upsell** (Priority 3)
     4. **Fair Hadiah** (Priority 4)
     5. **Tebus Murah** (Priority 5)

5. **Layanan Promosi (Promotion Services)**
   Masing-masing service bertanggung jawab meng-generate string formula Google Sheets yang presisi:
   - **`KartonanService.gs`**: Formula diskon kartonan `=IFERROR(ROUNDDOWN(Qty/Frac,0)*DiskonKrt, 0)`.
   - **`BundlingService.gs`**: Formula diskon paket bundling (% benefit atau fixed Rp) dan prorata pembagian nilai diskon per PLU dengan balancing selisih di item terakhir.
   - **`PHGService.gs`**: Formula pembebasan harga produk hadiah gratis `=GrossPrice`.
   - **`HargaCoretService.gs`**: Formula harga coret fixed benefit atau % benefit berdasar kelipatan dan limitasi max.
   - **`UpsellService.gs`**: Formula upsell baik mekanisme per PLU (`Campur = N`) maupun akumulasi total belanja grup PLU (`Campur = Y`), prorata proporsional ke tiap item.
   - **`FairPotalService.gs`**: Formula promosi Fair Potongan Langsung (% benefit atau potongan fixed Rp) berdasar syarat belanja minimum net sales after previous promo.
   - **`FairTMHService.gs`**: Formula tebus murah fair `=MIN(HargaTebus*Qty, NetAfterPrev)`.
   - **`FairHadiahService.gs`**: Formula fair hadiah gratis.
   - **`DABService.gs`**: Formula Diskon Alat Bayar (DAB) di level keranjang/fair beserta prorata ke seluruh item yang eligible.
   - **`PointStampService.gs`**: Formula perolehan poin dan stamp (Base, Fair, Cart).

6. **`ResultSheetBuilder.gs`**
   - Menghitung nama tab baru berikutnya (`Result - 1`, `Result - 2`, dst.).
   - Menyusun layout tabel berurutan:
     - Tabel referensi promosi aktif di bagian atas.
     - Tabel `SALES` (Order Awal) lengkap dengan formula step-by-step.
     - Tabel `EDIT ORDER` & `Detail Transaksi` Order Awal.
     - Tabel `FULFILLMENT SALES` (Order Aktual setelah alokasi stok).
     - Tabel `REFUND` (Selisih Qty Refund, Gross Refund, Clawback Promo, Net Refund).
     - Tabel `Detail Transaksi` Pemenuhan & Refund.
   - Menerapkan styling warna cell, garis border, dan format angka mata uang (`Rp#,##0`).

---

## 4. Hirarki Waterfall Promosi

Urutan perhitungan potongan harga (step-by-step waterfall) yang diinjeksikan pada rumus adalah:
$$\text{Gross Sales} \xrightarrow{-} \text{Karton} \xrightarrow{-} \text{Bundling} \xrightarrow{-} \text{PHG} \xrightarrow{-} \text{Harga Coret} \xrightarrow{-} \text{Upsell} \xrightarrow{-} \text{Fair Potal} \xrightarrow{-} \text{Fair TMH} \xrightarrow{-} \text{Diskon Alat Bayar (DAB)}$$

Setiap kolom diskon memotong kolom `Net Sales After ...` sebelumnya secara konsisten, baik pada tabel `SALES`, `FULFILLMENT SALES`, maupun kalkulasi penyesuaian pada tabel `REFUND`.

---

## 5. Langkah Eksekusi Selanjutnya
Setelah rencana ini disetujui:
1. Menulis seluruh modul file `.gs` di direktori workspace dengan struktur rapi.
2. Memberikan panduan langkah demi langkah cara memasang script ke Google Spreadsheet (`Extensions > Apps Script`).
3. Menguji alur kalkulasi dan memastikan seluruh formula matematika identik dengan hasil perhitungan manual di sheet referensi Anda.

# Helper Simulasi Perhitungan Promosi & Refund (Google Apps Script)

Helper ini dirancang untuk memproses simulasi perhitungan promosi bertingkat (*waterfall promo accounting*) dan partial refund pada Google Spreadsheet dengan menghasilkan **formula Google Sheets aktif** (`=CEILING(...)`, `=ROUNDDOWN(...)`, `=VLOOKUP(...)`, dll.) pada setiap sel hasil kalkulasi agar dapat diaudit dan dianalisa secara transparan.

---

## 📁 Struktur Modul & File Script (OOP)

Proyek ini dibangun secara modular menggunakan prinsip Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) dan dibagi menjadi beberapa service berkas `.gs`:

| Nama File | Deskripsi / Tanggung Jawab |
| :--- | :--- |
| **`Main.gs`** | Entry point untuk custom menu Google Sheets (`Simulasi Promo & Refund`) dan fungsi orkestrasi utama. |
| **`Models.gs`** | Definisi class model data (`Product`, `PromoRule`, `TransactionItem`, `EditOrderRow`). |
| **`DataLoader.gs`** | Membaca dan memvalidasi data dari tab `PLU Master` dan tab `Input`. |
| **`QtyDistributionService.gs`** | Mendistribusikan total stok / Qty Aktual per PLU ke baris transaksi berdasarkan prioritas pemenuhan. |
| **`KartonanService.gs`** | Formula diskon kartonan dan *Net Sales After Karton*. |
| **`BundlingService.gs`** | Formula diskon paket bundling (% benefit atau Rp benefit) dan prorata nilai diskon ke tiap PLU. |
| **`PHGService.gs`** | Formula Produk Hadiah Gratis (pembebasan harga produk hadiah). |
| **`HargaCoretService.gs`** | Formula promo Harga Coret (fixed benefit Rp atau % benefit) dengan batas limitasi. |
| **`UpsellService.gs`** | Formula promo Upsell baik per PLU (`Campur = N`) maupun akumulasi total belanja grup PLU (`Campur = Y`). |
| **`FairPotalService.gs`** | Formula promo Fair Potongan Langsung (% benefit atau Rp benefit) berdasar syarat belanja minimum. |
| **`FairTMHService.gs`** | Formula Fair Tebus Murah. |
| **`FairHadiahService.gs`** | Formula Fair Hadiah Gratis. |
| **`DABService.gs`** | Formula Diskon Alat Bayar (DAB) di level keranjang/fair beserta prorata nilai ke seluruh item. |
| **`PointStampService.gs`** | Formula perolehan poin dan stamp (Base, Fair, Cart). |
| **`ResultSheetBuilder.gs`** | Pembangkit tab result baru (`Result - 1`, `Result - 2`, dst.), penyusun tata letak tabel, injeksi formula, dan styling visual. |

---

## 🚀 Panduan Pemasangan ke Google Spreadsheet

1. Buka spreadsheet Google Anda (misalnya spreadsheet referensi yang telah Anda buat).
2. Pada menu atas Google Sheets, klik menu **Extensions** (Ekstensi) > **Apps Script**.
3. Di editor Apps Script:
   - Buat file script baru untuk setiap file `.gs` di atas (klik tombol **`+`** di sebelah "Files" > pilih **Script**).
   - Beri nama sesuai daftar file (contoh: `Main`, `Models`, `DataLoader`, `QtyDistributionService`, `KartonanService`, `BundlingService`, `PHGService`, `HargaCoretService`, `UpsellService`, `FairPotalService`, `FairTMHService`, `FairHadiahService`, `DABService`, `PointStampService`, `ResultSheetBuilder`).
   - Salin (*copy-paste*) kode dari masing-masing file lokal ke editor Apps Script.
4. Klik tombol **Save** (ikon disket) atau tekan `Ctrl + S`.
5. Muat ulang (*refresh*) halaman Google Spreadsheet Anda di browser.
6. Menu baru bernama **`Simulasi Promo & Refund`** akan otomatis muncul pada bilah menu atas Google Sheets.

---

## 💡 Cara Penggunaan

### 1. Menyiapkan Data di Tab `Input` & `PLU Master`
- Pastikan tab **`PLU Master`** memuat daftar PLU, nama produk, harga satuan, dan data kartonan (`FRAC_KRT`, `PRICE_KRT`, `Benefit Rp`).
- Pada tab **`Input`**:
  - Tabel **`KODE PROMOSI INPUT`**: Masukkan aturan promo aktif (tipe promo, kode promo, qty/rp min, benefit, PLU syarat, limitasi max).
  - Tabel **`TRANSACTION & REFUND INPUT`**: Masukkan paket transaksi awal (Bundling, Non-Paket, Hadiah PHG, Fair Hadiah, Tebus Murah) beserta `Qty Beli`.
  - Masukkan juga `Qty Aktual` (stok yang tersedia) jika sudah ditentukan.

### 2. Menjalankan Perhitungan
- Klik menu **`Simulasi Promo & Refund`** > pilih **`1. Hitung & Buat Tab Result Baru`**.
- Script akan otomatis:
  1. Memvalidasi data (memastikan PLU valid, Qty tidak bernilai minus, dan Qty Aktual tidak melebihi Qty Beli).
  2. Mendistribusikan alokasi stok fisik ke paket berdasarkan hierarki prioritas:
     $$\text{Bundling} \rightarrow \text{Hadiah PHG} \rightarrow \text{Non-Paket / Upsell} \rightarrow \text{Fair Hadiah} \rightarrow \text{Tebus Murah}$$
  3. Membuat tab baru dengan nomor urut berikutnya (misal: `Result - 1`, `Result - 2`).
  4. Menuliskan seluruh tabel dengan formula Google Sheets aktif:
     - **Tabel Tipe Promo** (referensi parameter promo di baris atas).
     - **Tabel SALES** (Gross Sales, Diskon Karton, Bundling, PHG, Harga Coret, Upsell 1..N, Fair Potal 1..N, Fair TMH, DAB, Poin & Stamp).
     - **Tabel EDIT ORDER** (Ringkasan per PLU: Qty Beli, Qty Stok, Qty Refund).
     - **Tabel Detail Transaksi Order Awal** (Total Harga, Diskon Base, Fair Potal, Hadiah/TMH, Sebelum DAB, DAB, Total Pembayaran).
     - **Tabel FULFILLMENT SALES** (Perhitungan ulang penjualan berdasarkan Qty Aktual).
     - **Tabel REFUND** (Gross refund, selisih promo clawback, net refund).
     - **Tabel Detail Transaksi Pemenuhan & Refund** (Total Pemenuhan, Total Fulfillment, Refund Amount, Total Refund Paid).

### 3. Fitur Tambahan: Auto-Distribusi Qty ke Input
Jika Anda hanya ingin mengisi kolom `Qty Aktual` pada tab `Input` secara otomatis berdasarkan prioritas pemenuhan tanpa membuat tab result terlebih dahulu, klik:
- Menu **`Simulasi Promo & Refund`** > pilih **`2. Auto-Distribusi Qty Stok ke Input`**.

<summary>
1. **Task Overview**
   - **Core Request**: Build a Google Apps Script helper for simulating retail promotional calculations and partial order refunds step-by-step, matching the reference Google Spreadsheet: `https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1krkFeo8XVKz-_4ksLPShdbYWhIoqFJ4_16bLCkeZuVE/edit?gid=1775217777#gid=1775217777` (Spreadsheet ID: `1krkFeo8XVKz-_4ksLPShdbYWhIoqFJ4_16bLCkeZuVE`).
   - **Latest User Request (`/plan`)**: "mari kita kerjakan 1 per 1 dari script yang sudah ada agar output sesuai dengan apa yang saya inginkan" — The user triggered `/plan` mode to systematically review, refine, and align each script/section one by one so that the generated output matches their exact expectations in the reference sheet (`Result Refference`, `gid=1775217777`).
   - **Resolved Requirements & Decisions (from `/grill-me`)**:
     1. **UI / Interaction**: Custom menu (`Simulasi Promo & Refund`) in Google Sheets reading from tab `Input` and `PLU Master`.
     2. **Input Mechanism**: Tab `Input` contains `KODE PROMOSI INPUT` (promo rules) and `TRANSACTION & REFUND INPUT` (initial order by package/item). Product names, prices, and carton fractions are matched from `PLU Master`.
     3. **Dynamic Waterfall Columns**: Promo columns in `SALES`, `FULFILLMENT SALES`, and `REFUND` are generated dynamically following the active promos in `Input` in the waterfall hierarchy: `Gross Sales -> Diskon Karton -> Bundling -> PHG -> Harga Coret -> Upsell -> Fair Potal -> Fair TMH / Fair Hadiah -> Diskon Alat Bayar (DAB) -> Point & Stamp`.
     4. **Stock Distribution Priority**: Total `Qty Aktual / Stok` per PLU is distributed automatically by priority: `1. Bundling -> 2. Hadiah PHG -> 3. Non-Paket / Upsell -> 4. Fair Hadiah -> 5. Fair Tebus Murah`.
     5. **Cell Values**: Cells must contain active Google Sheets formulas (e.g., `=CEILING(MIN(ROUNDDOWN(sum(E72)/C34),L34)*E34,100)`, `=VLOOKUP(...)`, `=IFERROR(...)`), NOT static numbers, and no right-side auxiliary tables (unlike `Result - 1`).
     6. **Tab Management**: Each run creates a new numbered tab (`Result - 1`, `Result - 2`, etc.).
     7. **Architecture**: Modular OOP in `.gs` files, separated by service (`HargaCoretService.gs`, `BundlingService.gs`, etc.).
     8. **Error Handling**: Alert dialog (`ui.alert`) when validation fails.

2. **Progress**
   - **Reference Data Downloaded & Inspected** (in `c:\Users\Muhammad Andreansyah\Documents\Project\Calculate`):
     - `spreadsheet.xlsx`: Full export of the reference Google Sheet with all 5 tabs (`PLU Master`, `Input`, `Copy of Input`, `Result - 1 `, `Result Refference `) and their exact underlying formulas.

     - `Main.gs`: `onOpen()`, `calculateAndGenerateResult()`, `autoDistributeQtyToInput()`, `generateInputTemplate()`, `generatePluMasterTemplate()`.
     - `Models.gs`: `parseNumber()`, `Product`, `PromoRule`, `TransactionItem`, `EditOrderRow`.
     - `DataLoader.gs`: Reads and validates `PLU Master` and `Input`.
     - `QtyDistributionService.gs`: Allocates stock by package priority and builds `EditOrderRow` summaries.
     - `InputTemplateBuilder.gs`: Generates formatted `Input` and `PLU Master` tabs with sample data.
     - Promotion Services: `KartonanService.gs`, `BundlingService.gs`, `PHGService.gs`, `HargaCoretService.gs`, `UpsellService.gs`, `FairPotalService.gs`, `FairTMHService.gs`, `FairHadiahService.gs`, `DABService.gs`, `PointStampService.gs`.
     - `ResultSheetBuilder.gs`: Builds the `Result - X` tab (`Tipe Promo`, `SALES`, `EDIT ORDER`, `Detail Transaksi`, `FULFILLMENT SALES`, `REFUND`, `Detail Transaksi Refund`).

3. **Key Findings**
   - **Reference Sheet (`Result Refference `) Exact Structure & Formulas**:
     - **Promo Table (Rows 6–66)**: Multi-PLU promos (like `Bundling`, `Upsell`, `Fair Potal`, `Fair DAB`, `Base Poin/Stamp`) list each `PLU Syarat` on its own sub-row in Column H (`PLU Syarat`) with `=VLOOKUP(H{row},'PLU Master'!B:C, 2, FALSE)` in Column I (`Nama Produk`), whereas our current `ResultSheetBuilder.gs` puts all `PLU Syarat` into a single newline-separated cell per promo rule.
     - **Promo Table Ordering & Type Naming**: In `Result Refference `, promos are ordered and labeled specifically (e.g., `Non Base - Bundling`, `Base - Poin`, `Base - Stamp`, `Base - Upsell`, `Base - Harga Coret`, `Fair - Potal`, `Fair - DAB`, `Fair Hadiah`, `Fair Tebus Murah`, `Non Base - Produk Hadiah`, `Fair - Poin`, `Cart - Poin`, `Fair - Stamp`, `Cart - Stamp`), whereas `Input` lists `Harga Coret`, `Upsell`, `Bundling`, `PHG`, etc.

4. **Errors & Fixes**
   - **Error 1**: `gsheets` CLI failed with `no credentials found`. Worked around by exporting the public Google Sheet directly via `curl.exe -sL ".../export?format=xlsx" -o spreadsheet.xlsx` and inspecting formulas via Python `openpyxl`.
   - **Error 2**: `SyntaxError: Identifier 'EditOrderRow' has already been declared (anonymous) @ QtyDistributionService.gs:1` in Google Apps Script.
     - *Root Cause*: `var { EditOrderRow } = require('./Models.gs')` in `QtyDistributionService.gs` clashed with `class EditOrderRow` in `Models.gs` because all `.gs` files share the global scope in Apps Script V8.
     - *Fix*: Removed `require` from `QtyDistributionService.gs` and used `global.EditOrderRow` in local Node test scripts.
   - **Error 3**: Menu items 3 & 4 didn't appear initially in the user's sheet.

   - **Error 4**: `Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'buildNetAfterFormula')`.

   - **Error 6**: Rows 1–14 and 17–23 in the `Tipe Promo` table became completely blank except for `'-'` in Column I.
     - *Root Cause*: Calling `setValues([valuesRow])` followed by `setFormulas([formulasRow])` across all 12 columns (where non-formula columns were `null` in `formulasRow`) caused Google Sheets `setFormulas` to wipe out the values in all `null` formula columns.
     - *Fix*: Used `setValues([rowVal])` for the 12 columns and called `sheet.getRange(currentPromoRow, 9).setFormula(prodNameVal)` only on cell 9. Also fixed the same anti-pattern in `EDIT ORDER` and `InputTemplateBuilder.gs` (note: check `InputTemplateBuilder.gs` lines 155–160 which still has `setFormulas` followed by `setValues`!).

1: # Rencana Arsitektur & Implementasi: Google Apps Script Promo & Refund Helper
2: 
3: ## 1. Ringkasan Proyek
4: Helper Google Apps Script ini dirancang untuk membaca konfigurasi promosi dan transaksi belanja dari tab `Input`, mencocokkan master produk dari tab `PLU Master`, menghitung distribusi pemenuhan stok saat terjadi partial refund, dan menyusun tab hasil baru bertingkat (`Result - 1`, `Result - 2`, dst.) di mana setiap sel perhitungan berisikan **formula Google Sheets** aktif (`=CEILING(...)`, `=ROUNDDOWN(...)`, `=VLOOKUP(...)`, dll) untuk keperluan analisa dan audit step-by-step.
5: 
6: ---
7: 
8: ## 2. Diagram Alur Kerja & Arsitektur Sistem
9: 
10: ```mermaid
11: flowchart TD
12:     A["User klik Menu 'Simulasi Promo & Refund' -> 'Hitung & Buat Result Baru'"] --> B["Main.gs (Orchestrator)"]
13:     B --> C["DataLoader: Baca Tab 'Input' & 'PLU Master'"]
14:     C --> D{"Validasi Input"}
15:     D -- "Ada Error (PLU hilang / Qty invalid)" --> E["ui.alert() Tampilkan Pesan Error & Stop"]
16:     D -- "Valid" --> F["QtyDistributionService: Alokasi Qty Aktual ke Paket"]
17:     F --> G["Deteksi & Pemetaan Kolom Promosi Aktif"]
18:     G --> H["ResultSheetBuilder: Buat Tab 'Result - X'"]
19:     H --> I["Injeksi Formula Tabel SALES (Order Awal)"]
20:     H --> J["Injeksi Formula Tabel EDIT ORDER & Detail Transaksi"]
21:     H --> K["Injeksi Formula Tabel FULFILLMENT SALES (Order Aktual)"]
22:     H --> L["Injeksi Formula Tabel REFUND & Detail Transaksi Refund"]
23:     H --> M["Format Tampilan (Border, Warna Header, Format Rupiah)"]
24:     M --> N["Selesai & Notifikasi Tab Baru Siap Digunakan"]
25: ```
26: 
27: ---
28: 
29: ## 3. Struktur Berkas Apps Script (Modular OOP)
30: 
31: Setiap tipe promosi dan logika perhitungan dipisahkan menjadi berkas `.gs` tersendiri menggunakan paradigma Object-Oriented Programming (OOP):
32: 
33: 1. **`Main.gs`**
34:    - Entry point spreadsheet (`onOpen`).
35:    - Handler menu custom: `"Simulasi Promo & Refund"`.
36:    - Koordinasi orkestrasi pembacaan data, validasi, dan pembangkitan sheet result.
37: 
38: 2. **`Models.gs`**
39:    - Definisi class model data: `Product`, `PromoRule`, `OrderItem`, `EditOrderSummary`.
40: 
41: 3. **`DataLoader.gs`**
42:    - Service untuk membaca range data dari tab `PLU Master` dan `Input`.
43:    - Parsing aturan promo (`KODE PROMOSI INPUT`) dan baris transaksi awal.
44:    - Validasi data (mengecek keberadaan PLU, validitas Qty, angka numerik).
45: 
46: 4. **`QtyDistributionService.gs`**
47:    - Logika cerdas untuk mendistribusikan total `Qty Aktual` per PLU dari Edit Order ke transaksi awal dengan hierarki prioritas:
48:      1. **Bundling** (Priority 1)
49:      2. **Hadiah PHG** (Priority 2)
50:      3. **Non-Paket / Upsell** (Priority 3)
51:      4. **Fair Hadiah** (Priority 4)
52:      5. **Tebus Murah** (Priority 5)
53: 
54: 5. **Layanan Promosi (Promotion Services)**
55:    Masing-masing service bertanggung jawab meng-generate string formula Google Sheets yang presisi:
56:    - **`KartonanService.gs`**: Formula diskon kartonan `=IFERROR(ROUNDDOWN(Qty/Frac,0)*DiskonKrt, 0)`.
57:    - **`BundlingService.gs`**: Formula diskon paket bundling (% benefit atau fixed Rp) dan prorata pembagian nilai diskon per PLU dengan balancing selisih di item terakhir.
58:    - **`PHGService.gs`**: Formula pembebasan harga produk hadiah gratis `=GrossPrice`.
59:    - **`HargaCoretService.gs`**: Formula harga coret fixed benefit atau % benefit berdasar kelipatan dan limitasi max.
60:    - **`UpsellService.gs`**: Formula upsell baik mekanisme per PLU (`Campur = N`) maupun akumulasi total belanja grup PLU (`Campur = Y`), prorata proporsional ke tiap item.
61:    - **`FairPotalService.gs`**: Formula promosi Fair Potongan Langsung (% benefit atau potongan fixed Rp) berdasar syarat belanja minimum net sales after previous promo.
62:    - **`FairTMHService.gs`**: Formula tebus murah fair `=MIN(HargaTebus*Qty, NetAfterPrev)`.
63:    - **`FairHadiahService.gs`**: Formula fair hadiah gratis.
64:    - **`DABService.gs`**: Formula Diskon Alat Bayar (DAB) di level keranjang/fair beserta prorata ke seluruh item yang eligible.
65:    - **`PointStampService.gs`**: Formula perolehan poin dan stamp (Base, Fair, Cart).
66: 
67: 6. **`ResultSheetBuilder.gs`**
68:    - Menghitung nama tab baru berikutnya (`Result - 1`, `Result - 2`, dst.).
69:    - Menyusun layout tabel berurutan:
70:      - Tabel referensi promosi aktif di bagian atas.
71:      - Tabel `SALES` (Order Awal) lengkap dengan formula step-by-step.
72:      - Tabel `EDIT ORDER` & `Detail Transaksi` Order Awal.
73:      - Tabel `FULFILLMENT SALES` (Order Aktual setelah alokasi stok).
74:      - Tabel `REFUND` (Selisih Qty Refund, Gross Refund, Clawback Promo, Net Refund).
75:      - Tabel `Detail Transaksi` Pemenuhan & Refund.
76:    - Menerapkan styling warna cell, garis border, dan format angka mata uang (`Rp#,##0`).
77: 
78: ---
79: 
80: ## 4. Hirarki Waterfall Promosi
81: 
82: Urutan perhitungan potongan harga (step-by-step waterfall) yang diinjeksikan pada rumus adalah:
83: $$\text{Gross Sales} \xrightarrow{-} \text{Karton} \xrightarrow{-} \text{Bundling} \xrightarrow{-} \text{PHG} \xrightarrow{-} \text{Harga Coret} \xrightarrow{-} \text{Upsell} \xrightarrow{-} \text{Fair Potal} \xrightarrow{-} \text{Fair TMH} \xrightarrow{-} \text{Diskon Alat Bayar (DAB)}$$
84: 
85: Setiap kolom diskon memotong kolom `Net Sales After ...` sebelumnya secara konsisten, baik pada tabel `SALES`, `FULFILLMENT SALES`, maupun kalkulasi penyesuaian pada tabel `REFUND`.
86: 
87: ---
88: 
89: ## 5. Langkah Eksekusi Selanjutnya
90: Setelah rencana ini disetujui:
91: 1. Menulis seluruh modul file `.gs` di direktori workspace dengan struktur rapi.
92: 2. Memberikan panduan langkah demi langkah cara memasang script ke Google Spreadsheet (`Extensions > Apps Script`).
93: 3. Menguji alur kalkulasi dan memastikan seluruh formula matematika identik dengan hasil perhitungan manual di sheet referensi Anda.

args.Content:
# Rencana Penyempurnaan Step-by-Step: Penyelarasan Script dengan `Result Refference`

Untuk memastikan output tab `Result - X` yang dihasilkan oleh script 100% identik dengan tab **`Result Refference`** pada spreadsheet Anda, kita akan mengerjakan perbaikan secara bertahap **1 per 1** dibagi menjadi **5 Tahap**.

---

## Ringkasan 5 Tahap Pengerjaan

```mermaid
flowchart LR
    T1["Tahap 1\nInputTemplateBuilder &\nTabel Tipe Promo"] --> T2["Tahap 2\nTabel SALES &\nFormula Promo Awal"]
    T2 --> T3["Tahap 3\nTabel EDIT ORDER &\nDetail Transaksi Awal"]
    T3 --> T4["Tahap 4\nTabel FULFILLMENT SALES\n(Order Aktual)"]
    T4 --> T5["Tahap 5\nTabel REFUND &\nDetail Transaksi Akhir"]
```

---

## Detail Perubahan per Tahap

### Tahap 1: Perbaikan Template Input & Tabel Referensi Promosi (`Tipe Promo` di Baris Atas Result)
**Berkas yang diperbaiki:** [InputTemplateBuilder.gs](file:///c:/Users/Muhammad%20Andreansyah/Documents/Project/Calculate/InputTemplateBuilder.gs), [Models.gs](file:///c:/Users/Muhammad%20Andreansyah/Documents/Project/Calculate/Models.gs), [ResultSheetBuilder.gs](file:///c:/Users/Muhammad%20Andreansyah/Documents/Project/Calculate/ResultSheetBuilder.gs)

1. **Perbaikan Bug `PLU Master` di [`InputTemplateBuilder.generatePluMasterSheet`](file:///c:/Users/Muhammad%20Andreansyah/Documents/Project/Calculate/InputTemplateBuilder.gs#L137-L202)**:
   - Saat ini pemanggilan `setFormulas` diikuti `setValues` menimpa rumus kolom `G`, `H`, `I` (`Harga per pcs`, `Benefit Rp`, `Benefit %`) menjadi kosong. Akan diperbaiki agar nilai kolom `A-F` dan formula kolom `G-I` ditulis terpisah tanpa saling menimpa.
2. **Ekspansi Baris Multi-PLU pada Tabel `Tipe Promo` di [`ResultSheetBuilder.build`](file:///c:/Users/Muhammad%20Andreansyah/Documents/Project/Calculate/ResultSheetBuilder.gs#L56-L122)**:
   - Di `Result Refference` (Baris 6–66), jika satu `Kode Promo` memiliki beberapa `PLU Syarat` (misal `PLFBDL04` memiliki 3 PLU), maka **setiap PLU ditulis pada sub-baris tersendiri** di kolom `H` (`PLU Syarat`), dan kolom `I` (`Nama Produk`) berisi formula `=IFERROR(VLOOKUP(H{baris},'PLU Master'!$B:$C, 2, FALSE),"-")` di setiap barisnya.
   - Kolom `Tipe Promo` hanya ditampilkan pada baris pertama dari grup tipe promo yang sama (baris berikutnya dalam tipe promo yang sama dikosongkan di kolom `A` seperti pada `Result Refference`).
   - Menyimpan `rule.resultRow` pada baris pertama masing-masing `Kode Promo` agar seluruh formula di tabel `SALES` dan `FULFILLMENT SALES` tetap merujuk ke baris parameter (`Mekanisme Beli`, `% Benefit`, `Rp Benefit`, `Limitasi Max`) yang tepat.

---

### Tahap 2: Penyempurnaan Tabel `SALES` (Order Awal) & Layanan Promosi
**Berkas yang diperbaiki:** [ResultSheetBuilder.gs](file:///c:/Users/Muhammad%20Andreansyah/Documents/Project/Calculate/ResultSheetBuilder.gs), [HargaCoretService.gs](file:///c:/Users/Muhammad%20Andreansyah/Documents/Project/Calculate/HargaCoretService.gs), [UpsellService.gs](file:///c:/Users/Muhammad%20Andreansyah/Documents/Project/Calculate/UpsellService.gs), [FairPotalService.gs](file:///c:/Users/Muhammad%20Andreansyah/Documents/Project/Calculate/FairPotalService.gs), [DABService.gs](file:///c:/Users/Muhammad%20Andreansyah/Documents/Project/Calculate/DABService.gs), [PointStampService.gs](file:///c:/Users/Muhammad%20Andreansyah/Documents/Project/Calculate/PointStampService.gs)

1. **Pemetaan Kolom Dinamis (`Column Map Tracker`)**:
   - Menyimpan indeks/huruf kolom setiap promo di `SALES` ke dalam objek peta (`salesColMap`) agar tidak ada lagi huruf kolom yang di-*hardcode* saat dirujuk oleh `Detail Transaksi`, `FULFILLMENT SALES`, maupun `REFUND`.
2. **Cakupan Baris Eligible Promosi (`Non-Paket` vs `Paket Hadiah / Bundling`)**:
   - Di `Result Refference`, perhitungan `Harga Coret`, `Upsell`, serta `Base Poin / Base Stamp` hanya menghitung item pada baris **Non-Paket** (item `Bundling`, `Hadiah PHG`, `Fair Hadiah`, dan `Tebus Murah` tidak ikut mendapatkan diskon Harga Coret / Upsell / Base Poin).
   - Untuk `Fair Potal`: menghitung item `Non-Paket` dan `Bundling` yang termasuk dalam daftar `PLU Syarat` (tidak menghitung baris `Hadiah PHG`, `Fair Hadiah`, dan `Tebus Murah`).
   - Untuk `Fair DAB`: menghitung seluruh baris transaksi yang memiliki `Net Sales After Fair TMH > 0`, dengan baris terakhir atau baris penyeimbang menggunakan rumus selisih (`=TotalDAB - SUM(baris_lain)`) agar total prorata 100% pas tanpa selisih pembulatan.
   - Untuk `Fair Poin` & `Fair Stamp`: menjumlahkan `Net Sales After Fair TMH` untuk PLU yang memenuhi syarat sesuai `Result Refference`.
   - Untuk `Cart Poin` & `Cart Stamp`: menggunakan formula sesuai `Result Refference`: `=CEILING(MIN(ROUNDDOWN(SUM(NetAfterDAB)/C{row},0)*C{row},L{row})/C{row}*F{row},1)`.

---

### Tahap 3: Tabel `EDIT ORDER` & `Detail Transaksi` (Order Awal)
**Berkas yang diperbaiki:** [ResultSheetBuilder.gs](file:///c:/Users/Muhammad%20Andreansyah/Documents/Project/Calculate/ResultSheetBuilder.gs)

1. **Tabel `EDIT ORDER`**:
   - Memastikan kolom `PLU`, `Judul Produk` (`VLOOKUP`), `Qty Beli` (`SUMIF`), `Qty Stok`, dan `Qty Refund` (`=C-D`) terformat rapi.
2. **Tabel `Detail Transaksi` (Order Awal)**:
   - Memastikan rumus `Diskon Base` menjumlahkan seluruh kolom `/ PLU` dari promo Base (`Karton`, `Bundling / PLU`, `Harga Coret / PLU`, dan semua `Upsell / PLU`) menggunakan referensi kolom dinamis dari `salesColMap`.
   - Memastikan `Fair Potal` menjumlahkan seluruh kolom total `Fair Potal` aktif.
   - Memastikan `Diskon Hadiah & Tebus Murah` menjumlahkan `PHG/PLU` + `Fair TMH/PLU` secara akurat.

---

### Tahap 4: Tabel `FULFILLMENT SALES` (Order Aktual)
**Berkas yang diperbaiki:** [ResultSheetBuilder.gs](file:///c:/Users/Muhammad%20Andreansyah/Documents/Project/Calculate/ResultSheetBuilder.gs), [UpsellService.gs](file:///c:/Users/Muhammad%20Andreansyah/Documents/Project/Calculate/UpsellService.gs), [FairPotalService.gs](file:///c:/Users/Muhammad%20Andreansyah/Documents/Project/Calculate/FairPotalService.gs), [FairTMHService.gs](file:///c:/Users/Muhammad%20Andreansyah/Documents/Project/Calculate/FairTMHService.gs), [DABService.gs](file:///c:/Users/Muhammad%20Andreansyah/Documents/Project/Calculate/DABService.gs), [PointStampService.gs](file:///c:/Users/Muhammad%20Andreansyah/Documents/Project/Calculate/PointStampService.gs)

1. **Referensi Baris ke Tabel `SALES`**:
   - Kolom `B` (`PLU`), `C` (`Judul Produk`), `D` (`Harga`), `E` (`Qty`) merujuk langsung ke baris `SALES` (`=B{sr}`, `=C{sr}`, `=D{sr}`, `=E{sr}`).
2. **Menghapus Seluruh *Hardcoded Column Letters* (`M`, `X`, `R`, `AD`, `AJ`, `AL`, `AM`, `AP`, `AT`)**:
   - Menggantinya dengan referensi dinamis dari `salesColMap` dan `fulfillColMap` sehingga berapa pun jumlah promo yang diinput user, rumus tidak akan pernah meleset kolomnya.
3. **Penyelarasan Formula Rekalkulasi dengan `Result Refference`**:
   - **Fair Potal (Fulfillment)**: Menggunakan sel `L{pot.resultRow}` (bukan angka statis) untuk pembagi `Limitasi Max`: `=MIN(CEILING((SUM(...)/L{row})*{salesTotalCell},100),{salesTotalCell})`.
   - **Fair TMH & Hadiah (Fulfillment)**: Menggunakan formula proporsional `=IFERROR(F{fr}*(AK{sr}/E{sr}),0)` (atau `=AG{fr}` untuk Fair Hadiah sesuai referensi).
   - **Base Poin & Base Stamp (Fulfillment)**: Mendukung penuh baik `Campur = N` maupun `Campur = Y` (saat ini `Campur = Y` seperti `HOKA090E` dan `HOKA090L` belum terhitung di Fulfillment).
   - **Baris Total Fulfillment**: Menambahkan rumus `=SUM(...)` untuk seluruh kolom `Point Received` dan `Stamp Received` di baris `Total Gross / Net Sales` seperti pada baris 133 di `Result Refference`.

---

### Tahap 5: Tabel `REFUND` & `Detail Transaksi` (Pemenuhan & Refund)
**Berkas yang diperbaiki:** [ResultSheetBuilder.gs](file:///c:/Users/Muhammad%20Andreansyah/Documents/Project/Calculate/ResultSheetBuilder.gs)

1. **Tabel `REFUND` (Selisih `SALES` dikurangi `FULFILLMENT SALES`)**:
   - Kolom `Upsell {Kode}` dan `Fair Potal {Kode}` pada tabel `REFUND`: di `Result Refference` berisi selisih `={SalesCol}{sr}-{FulfillCol}{fr}` (saat ini di script masih tertulis `=0`), lalu kolom `/ PLU` melakukan prorata/balancing atas selisih tersebut.
   - Kolom `Point Received` dan `Stamp Received` pada tabel `REFUND` beserta baris totalnya menghitung selisih `={SalesPtCol}{sr}-{FulfillPtCol}{fr}`.
2. **Tabel `Detail Transaksi` (Pemenuhan & Refund)**:
   - Mengganti seluruh *hardcoded column letters* (`J`, `N`, `H`, `AB`, `AE`, `AH`, `AJ`) pada rumus `Fulfillment Diskon`, `Fulfillment Promo Fair`, `Fulfillment Fair Tebus Murah & Hadiah`, `Fulfillment Diskon Alat Bayar` (dan pasangannya di bagian `Refund ...`) dengan referensi kolom dinamis dari `fulfillColMap` dan `refundColMap`.
   - Mengisi formula `Point Received`, `Point Fair`, `Stamp Received`, dan `Stamp Fair` agar merujuk ke baris Total Poin/Stamp di `FULFILLMENT SALES` (saat ini masih tertulis `=0`).
   - Memperbaiki jangkauan `applyFormatting` agar menyesuaikan jumlah kolom dinamis secara otomatis.

# Rencana Penyempurnaan Per Masing-Masing Script `.gs`

Berikut adalah rencana pengerjaan yang dipecah **1 per 1 untuk setiap berkas `.gs`** (total 16 berkas `.gs` di project Anda) agar output tab `Result - X` 100% selaras dengan **`Result Refference`**.

---

## Urutan Pengerjaan Per Script `.gs`

flowchart TD
    subgraph Fondasi["Kelompok 1: Fondasi & Input"]
        S1["1. Models.gs"] --> S2["2. InputTemplateBuilder.gs"]
        S2 --> S3["3. DataLoader.gs"]
        S3 --> S4["4. QtyDistributionService.gs"]
    end
    subgraph PromoBase["Kelompok 2: Service Promo Base & Paket"]
        S4 --> S5["5. KartonanService.gs"]
        S5 --> S6["6. BundlingService.gs"]
        S6 --> S7["7. PHGService.gs"]
        S7 --> S8["8. HargaCoretService.gs"]
        S8 --> S9["9. UpsellService.gs"]
    end
    subgraph PromoFair["Kelompok 3: Service Promo Fair, DAB & Loyalty"]
        S9 --> S10["10. FairPotalService.gs"]
        S10 --> S11["11. FairHadiahService.gs"]
        S11 --> S12["12. FairTMHService.gs"]

    end
    subgraph Builder["Kelompok 4: Builder & Orkestrator Utama"]
        S14 --> S15["15. ResultSheetBuilder.gs"]
        S15 --> S16["16. Main.gs"]
    end
```

---
